name: Agent Initiation Law
law: A candidate may only become canonical after a SUFFICIENT provenance witness from Breda, an independent attestation (attested_by != origin_model), a complete constitutional AgentDeclaration, and an ALLOW from GovernanceEngine. CONFLICTED provenance is routed to adjudication and held, not denied. INSUFFICIENT, INDETERMINATE, and WITHDRAWN assessments deny. Non-canonical, held, or forged entities may not be projected into Neo4j. Breda does not execute, approve, register, or write to Neo4j.
